# Saffron Grill — Full Knowledge Base & AI Agent Context

- **Brand Identity**: Authentic Indian Cuisine, Lunch Buffet & Luxury Event Catering

- **Payment Accepted**: Cash, Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, Apple Pay, Google Pay
- **Atmosphere**: Royal Indian fine-dining, family-friendly, corporate-friendly, warm gold and plum ambiance

## 2. Operating Schedule & Buffet Details
### Lunch Buffet Service
- **Monday through Friday**: 11:30 AM to 3:00 PM ($19.99 per adult, special children pricing)
- **Saturday and Sunday**: 12:00 PM to 3:30 PM ($21.99 per adult, Grand Weekend Feast)
- **Buffet Inclusions & Highlights**:
  - 20+ hot dishes rotated daily to ensure freshness and culinary diversity
  - Piping hot butter and garlic naan delivered freshly baked straight to your table
  - Multiple vegetarian curries (Paneer, Dal Makhani, mixed vegetable korma)
  - Halal non-vegetarian specialties (Butter Chicken, Lamb curry, Chicken Tikka)
  - Traditional clay tandoori sizzler stations
  - Cold salad bar, fresh cucumber raita, mint chutney, tamarind chutney, and mixed pickles
  - Authentic Indian desserts: Warm Gulab Jamun, Royal Rasmalai, Mango Kheer

### Dinner Service
- **Daily (7 Days / Week)**: 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM
- **Dinner Format**: Full à la carte dining with made-to-order curries, tandoori specialties, biryanis, and artisanal breads.
- **Customizable Spice Levels**: Mild, Medium, Hot, Extra Hot.

## 4. Dietary & Allergen Standards
- **Halal**: 100% of chicken, lamb, and goat meats served are Halal certified.
- **Vegetarian**: Dedicated separate preparation areas and cookware for vegetarian dishes.
- **Vegan**: Clearly marked plant-based curries including Chana Masala, Aloo Gobi, Yellow Dal Tadka, and Roti.
- **Gluten-Free**: Most curries, tandoori meats, basmati rice, and chaats are naturally gluten-free (tandoori breads contain wheat flour).
- **Nut Allergies**: Nut ingredients (cashews, almonds, coconut) are segregated; kitchen accommodates severe nut allergy notices upon request.

## 5. Catering & Private Event Packages
- **Scale**: Custom events from 25 to 1,000+ attendees.
- **Tiers**:
  - **Silver Feast ($22/person)**: 2 Appetizers (1 Veg, 1 Non-Veg), 2 Main Curries, Basmati Rice, Fresh Naan, Salad, Raita, Gulab Jamun.
  - **Royal Gold Banquet ($28/person)**: 3 Appetizers (including Tandoori Chicken), 3 Main Curries (Butter Chicken, Goat Curry, Dal Makhani), Hyderabadi Dum Biryani, Assorted Naans, Salad, Raita, Chutneys, 2 Desserts.
  - **Imperial Maharaja ($36/person)**: 4 Gourmet Appetizers, 4 Gourmet Entrées, Special Biryani, Gourmet Breads, Full Chutney Bar, 3 Desserts, Optional on-site live tandoor chef.
- **Services Provided**: Chafing dishes, sternos, serving ware, buffet setup, and trained hospitality staff.
- **Areas Served for Catering**: San Ramon, Danville, Dublin, Pleasanton, Blackhawk, Alamo, Livermore, Walnut Creek, Castro Valley, Fremont, and the wider San Francisco East Bay.

## 6. Location, Parking & Accessibility
- **Street Address**: 3191 Crow Canyon Pl, Ste D, San Ramon, CA 94583.
- **Landmark**: Situated inside Crow Canyon Plaza, adjacent to major shopping and retail centers.
- **Highway Access**: Immediate access from Interstate 680 (Crow Canyon Road exit).
- **Parking**: Ample complimentary on-site plaza surface parking with designated ADA accessible spots.
- **Wheelchair Accessibility**: Fully ADA compliant entrance, dining floor, and restrooms.

## 7. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Answers
- **Q: Does Saffron Grill offer a daily lunch buffet?**
  **A**: Yes, Saffron Grill serves an authentic Indian lunch buffet 7 days a week: Monday through Friday from 11:30 AM to 3:00 PM ($19.99/person), and Saturday and Sunday from 12:00 PM to 3:30 PM ($21.99/person). Fresh tandoori naan is brought directly to your table.
- **Q: Is the meat at Saffron Grill Halal?**
  **A**: Yes, all chicken, lamb, and goat meats at Saffron Grill are 100% Halal certified.
- **Q: Can I reserve a table online?**
  **A**: Yes, table reservations can be booked instantly online at https://saffrongrillrestaurant.com/reserve or by calling (925) 846-3077.
- **Q: Does Saffron Grill offer delivery and takeout?**
  **A**: Yes, takeout and online orders can be placed directly at https://order.boons.io/site/saffron-grill/390/y.
- **Q: Where can I find Indian catering in the Tri-Valley area?**
  **A**: Saffron Grill provides full-service Indian catering across San Ramon, Dublin, Pleasanton, Danville, and the entire East Bay, starting at $22 per guest with live tandoor options.
